title: ManagedExecutionRecord
description: Root type for the recorded managed-execution JSON Schema.

max_priority.description: Inclusive maximum explicit priority that a child may request.

min_priority.description: Inclusive minimum explicit priority that a child may request.

strength.description: `windows_job_object` in v0.1; kept explicit for Linux v0.2 provenance.

child_submission_policy.description: Maximum capabilities that authenticated managed descendants may request.

priority.description: Immutable urgency in `MIN_JOB_PRIORITY..=MAX_JOB_PRIORITY`; larger is more urgent.

ManagedParent.description: Server-authenticated identity of the primary Invocation that submitted child work.

working_directory.description: Defaults to the owning Job's working directory.

PrimaryInvocationResult.description: Immutable primary outcome recorded only after its Containment is proved empty.

ScalarReservation.description: Durable, finite promise of scalar capacity to one Pending Job.

ScalarResourceClaims.description: Scalar-only claim vector protected by a Reservation.

SubmissionRef.description: Durable identity of a managed submission, with any accepted execution identities known so far.
